reference: GNU coreutils pr, invoked by the harness with C locale, UTC, and the same fixture script; Bash type/help builtins provide the independent metadata contract.
coverage: single-column byte preservation and unterminated final records
balanced and across-column layouts with line numbering and control bytes
merged named files with a custom separator
form-feed page boundaries and selected pages
double spacing and header formatting with a fixed date format
invalid column geometry status and diagnostic presence
Repeated regular-file stdin redirections in a persistent shell.
exclusions: PTY streaming and early page flushing require a bounded private PTY driver; see the deferred case.
Unique long-option abbreviations and GNU translated diagnostics beyond the exercised error are outside this suite's scope.
This suite does not reproduce the repository's extensive form-feed, buffer-boundary, repeated-invocation, or sanitizer matrices.

cases.purpose: Compare terse single-column output for ordinary and empty records, including a final record without a newline.
Compare top-to-bottom balanced three-column layout and two-digit line numbers with a custom separator.
Compare left-to-right columns while records contain TAB, NUL, CR, and backspace bytes, plus numbering and a multi-byte separator.
Compare parallel merge of two relative fixture files with unequal lengths, a final unterminated record, numbering, and a custom separator.
cases.script:
printf 'red
blue
' > left; printf '1
2
3' > right; pr -t -m -n:2 -s' | ' left right

cases.purpose: Compare GNU page selection after an input form-feed boundary using terse output and an explicit page length.
Compare GNU page-width truncation in a single column while applying a left indent.
Compare terse double-spacing over a blank record and a final unterminated record.
Compare a headed file page with a literal date format and short deterministic page length, avoiding wall-clock-dependent output.
cases.script: printf 'alpha\nbeta\n' > report; pr -D FIXED -h SAMPLE -l12 report

cases.purpose: Reject zero columns with GNU status 1 and a diagnostic; implementation-specific wording and shell prefixes are not a CLI equality contract.
Check Bash's documented loadable contract: pr is reported as a builtin and its help entry is available.
cases.script: [[ $(type -t pr) == builtin ]] || exit 1; doc=$(help pr); printf 'builtin and help available\n'

cases.purpose: Verify complete page/row delivery while input remains open on an attached terminal.
cases.reason: The harness supplies closed stdin fixtures and no PTY driver. A future bounded private-PTY fixture should keep stdin open, feed enough records for a full page or across-column row, and compare candidate delivery timing and bytes with GNU pr without using a host terminal.

cases.purpose: Each invocation rereads its own relative input file in a persistent shell; compare complete output with GNU pr.
cases.script: printf 'first\nsecond' > input; pr -t < input; pr -t < input; printf 'new\n' > other; pr -t < other
